column1: # tests/memfn/row_floors.tsv — per-row CHOSEN floors ([MEMFN-ROWCON] N4,
# docs/design/memfn/row_contracts.md rev 4.1 §4). One line per row of
# tests/memfn/rows.tsv (run_rows.sh holds the two to the same row set).
# Columns (TAB-separated):
#   table, row     as rows.tsv
#   pcrec_floor    the least number of selections (define + run phases) of
#                  the row over pcrec's FULL N2 census: every --list-axes arm
#                  x both comment tiers x the whole corpus (c-default, c-vm,
#                  composition), summed from the MF_TRACE REACH lines.
#                  `-` for a row whose reach (rows.tsv) is not `pcrec`: such a
#                  row must be chosen 0 times there, and the census reports a
#                  nonzero count as a STALE reason.
#   g2_floor       the least number of selections of the row over G2 (memfn/
#                  tests/run_g2.sh, the quick tier).
# PLACEHOLDER = not measured yet. NO NUMBER HERE IS INVENTED: each comes
# from a run, and is written as floor(0.9 x measured) (the G2 floors' own
# "measured less ~10%" rule), by hand, with the run named in the commit.
# pcrec_floor is measured by the manager's full census, in a slot (Linux):
#   cd /home/pcrec/projects/pcrec && N2_LOCK=build/scratch/n2.lock \
#     OUT=build/scratch/n2_n4 CC=gcc JOBS=12 nohup \
#     bash docs/design/memfn/probes/rowcon/n2_census.sh \
#     > build/scratch/n2_n4.log 2>&1 & disown
#   # done when the log's last line is `== N2 DONE rc=0 would_decline=0 ==`;
#   # then: python3 docs/design/memfn/probes/rowcon/n2_report.py \
#   #   build/scratch/n2_n4 --floors tests/memfn/row_floors.tsv --propose
#   # prints the floor(0.9 x chosen) value for every row to copy in here.
# g2_floor is measured by G2's --quick tier with its rows half (memfn/tests/
# run_g2.sh --rows, linked against build/libpcrec_mftrace.a): the row-chosen
# lines, floor(0.9 x measured), pinned 2026-10-08 from a Linux run (seed
# 20261005; memfn/tests/G2ROWS_REPORT.md). `make test-memfn-g2` holds every row
# to it (check (e), G2_ROW_FLOORS=this file). The `fn` rows' g2 floors (lane
# r4e0, R4e'.0) are floor(0.9 x) of a Linux `make test-memfn-g2` run on
# 2026-10-09 (fn-pair 11580, fn-memchr 21091 chosen; docs/dev/lanes/
# r4e0_report.md §3); their pcrec floors are the slot census's.
# The SIMD rows `vrun-w16`/`vrun-w32` (lane r13, R-13): g2 floors are
# floor(0.9 x) of a Linux `make test-memfn-g2` run on 2026-10-09 (826 each,
# counted by G2's SIMD family's process; a named rung re-asked by kit_ask
# counts as chosen). Their pcrec floors are floor(0.9 x 78) = 70 each, from
# slot18's full census (lane/memfn-r13 2a44386a, 2026-10-10). Its
# -fmemfn-simd arm is the only one reaching them.
# The row `precheck_assign_byte` (lane r15b, R-15): reach pcrec since
# [REQ-HANDOFF-L1] (lane rlhbuild, abi 75): its pcrec floor is PLACEHOLDER until
# the full N2 census reads it (OWED, a slot). Its g2 floor is floor(0.9 x
# 802), the row's chosen count in a Linux run of G2's landmark sites (seed
# 20261005, `memfn/tests/run_g2_gate.sh`, 2026-10-11): those sites draw from
# their own stream, so the quick tier's generator renders the same ones and
# its count is at least that; a quick-tier reading is owed.
# The row `pf_walk`'s pcrec floor is floor(0.9 x 478404), slot24's census (kit
# branch lane/memfn-r17 c6a3bfea, 2026-10-12): R17-a (f2b16c801; ported to main
# as B0, lane fdb0) defines the VM hat's one-byte table once per site and uses it
# at both seeks, so 3204 hat sites count 1 define + 2 uses where they counted two
# defines (no byte moved; the identity sweeps are 0-mover). Re-read at main's
# next full N2 census (OWED, fdb0_report.md). RE-READ (lane n2fix, the B1+B2
# census at c0e465e99, b2heavy n2): pf_walk 533563 -> floor(0.9 x 533563) = 480206.
# The routed finder rows' pcrec floors (lane n2fix, the same census, chosen
# counts from n2_results.md; floor(0.9 x chosen)): D1 129159 = floor(0.9 x
# 143510) (pf_memchr 112482 + pf_memchr_bounded 31028), D1c 4287 = floor(0.9 x
# floor(0.9 x 334280): the unrouted default terminal, chosen at every FIND site
# no D1 row claims (pf_walk 533563 + pf_walk_bounded 35609 - D1w 234892). The
# g2 floors of D1/D1c/D1w stay PLACEHOLDER (G2 chooses them 0 times).
# The finder table's rows (table `fd`, R17-b' B1, lane fdb1): reach
# `pending-site:<step>` (rows.tsv), so pcrec_floor `-`, and the census reads
# them chosen 0 times: a finder decision is the MF_TRACE build's SHADOW, whose
# END records are phase `shadow` and never counted as chosen (memfn/src/gate.c).
# g2_floor PLACEHOLDER: G2 counts no shadow decision. Each routing step pins
# both columns for the rows it routes.
# R17-b' B3b (lane b3b) routed P0, P2, P3, P4 and P9 (reach `pcrec`): their
# pcrec floors are PLACEHOLDER until the B3b heavy chain's N2 census pins them
# (floor(0.9 x chosen), as n2fix pinned B2's; OWED, docs/dev/lanes/
# b3b_report.md). D2 stays `pending-site:R-18` (no pcrec site states a RUN
# span 0), so its pcrec floor stays `-`.
